_comment: Call sheet for the 12 review-confirmed dog-friendly properties. Ask exactly four things — pet fee TOTAL (per night or per stay), weight limit, how many dogs, and whether the dog can be left in the room unattended — then one bonus question that doubles as demand research: 'What do guests ask you most often before they book with a dog?' Log the date and the name of whoever told you. Nothing here renders until petFee.amount and verifiedDate are filled in.
_askedOnEveryCall: What is the pet fee, in total — is that per night or per stay?
Can the dog be left in the room unattended?
What do guests ask you most often before they book with a dog?

name: Dogfish Inn
evidenceNote: 4.9★ (544) — highest-rated lodging in the dataset. Guest review specifically cites the dog enjoying the stay. Bikes, fire pit, walkable to Lewes.

name: Canalside Inn
evidenceNote: 4.5★ (316). Multiple reviews cite pet-friendly atmosphere and outdoor space. NOTE: also a content competitor — they publish their own dog guide.

name: Breakers Hotel & Suites
evidenceNote: 4.2★ (795). Guest brought a dog for her 15th birthday; staff praised.

name: Adam's Ocean Front Motel
evidenceNote: 4.5★ (148). Strongest dog signal on the list — welcomed dogs with toys and treats; a guest stayed specifically for Doodles in Dewey weekend.

name: Hyatt Place Dewey Beach
evidenceNote: 4.3★ (1,374). Explicitly noted as dog friendly; bay and ocean both walkable.

name: Hotel Dewey
evidenceNote: 3.8★ (214). 'No frills pet-friendly stay in Dewey.' Dated but clean.

name: The Bay Resort Waterfront
evidenceNote: 4.2★ (478). Dog-friendly, but one guest flagged mismatched expectations — verify the policy carefully and publish the caveat.

name: Hotel Bethany Beach
evidenceNote: 4.3★ (916). Two separate reviews: 'pup friendly, which is why we stayed here.' Free beach chairs and umbrellas.

name: Seaside Inn
evidenceNote: 4.3★ (322). Pet friendly, with grass areas around the property for potty breaks.

name: Courtyard by Marriott Newark – University of Delaware
evidenceNote: 4.4★ (591). Best single detail found in the whole lodging sweep: ask for the room with a sliding door opening directly onto the dog park. Nobody publishes this — confirm it and it's yours.

name: Days Inn Wilmington/Brandywine
evidenceNote: 3.5★ (759). Pet friendly, but quality complaints are significant — publish with the caveat.

name: MainStay Suites Dover
evidenceNote: 4.1★ (438). Pet friendly; recent cleanliness complaints — include with caveat.
